title: Flightlog Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightlog:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often flightlog metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on flightlog metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out how often your flightlog metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
